headline: Late and priced: Fortive's beat and raise came out before the open; the stock is +5.1% from the close
reasoning: Source: Fortive's release on Business Wire, relayed by Benzinga at 09:33 ET: 'adjusted earnings per share of $0.77, surpassing the FactSet consensus estimate of $0.70 ... raised its full-year 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to a range of $3.10 to $3.14 per share, up from the previous forecast of $2.95 to $3.05'.

Move: 64.75 vs Tuesday's 61.62 close, +5.08% on 153,370 IEX shares. It peaked at 67.03 (+8.8%) and has given back about half. Benzinga listed it at 10:54 among 'Big Stocks Moving Higher On Wednesday'.
objections: Already traded +5.1%, over the 3% line; the peak has partly faded.
